answer: Every epoch, agents must broadcast a signed dune beacon proving continuous liveness; a stale signal flags the identity for slashing. Each agent stakes a unique jade token bound to a hardware-rooted key, so cloning identities requires acquiring and locking fresh tokens at rising cost. An attacker wanting N sybils must therefore fund N distinct stakes plus sustain N live beacons, making each fake identity costlier than the rewards it could farm. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
